findings.topic: 2. Directory layout, module system, IPC, and state management
findings.detail: Unusual but deliberate layout: Electron process code lives in src/ (src/main, src/preload, src/renderer — renderer contains ONLY index.html, main.tsx and styles/), while ALL feature/UI/data code lives in top-level '--module-*' directories that behave like workspace packages wired via path aliases (identical alias maps must be kept in sync in THREE places: electron.vite.config.ts, tsconfig.web.json/tsconfig.node.json paths, and vitest.config.ts). Aliases: '@' -> src/renderer, '@logger', '@logger/main', '@persistence', '@persistence/main', '@data', '@ui-kit', '@slot-system', '@test-utils', '@app', '@app/bootstrap', plus one alias per feature module ('@header', '@explorer', '@canvas', '@pr-detail', '@ai-chat', '@network', '@user-profile'). LAYERED IMPORT RULES enforced by Biome noRestrictedImports overrides per module (biome.json ~450 lines): Level 0 @logger; Level 1 @ui-kit, @data (cannot import each other); Level 2 @slot-system, @test-utils; Level 3 feature modules (header, canvas, explorer, pr-detail, ai-chat, network — cannot import each other); Level 4 @app. SLOT SYSTEM (--module-slot-system/index.tsx): modules self-register via registerToSlot({id, slot, component, order, visible}) into a useSyncExternalStore registry; App shell renders <Slot name="header"/> etc. with Suspense + SlotSkeleton fallback; SlotName union: 'header' | 'left-panel' | 'user-profile' | 'main' | 'right-panel' | 'pr-detail-panel' | 'ai-panel' | 'network-panel' | 'footer' | 'modal' | 'toast'. Bootstrap: --module-app/bootstrap.ts just imports each feature module for side-effect registration; src/renderer/main.tsx renders <QueryClientProvider><App/></QueryClientProvider>. Each feature module: index.tsx (wrapper hooked to @data + registerToSlot) + components/<Name>/{index.ts, Name.tsx, Name.test.tsx} one-component-per-folder convention. STATE: TanStack Query is the single source of truth for ALL state (no Redux/Zustand/signals) — reads via useQuery hooks in --module-data/queries/*, writes ONLY via useMutation hooks in --module-data/mutations/* (UI modules forbidden from setQueryData). Business logic lives in --module-data (github.ts GraphQL/REST client with direct fetch() from renderer, http.ts generic fetch wrapper with ETag cache and 30s timeout, keys.ts centralized query keys). IPC: channels are plain kebab-case strings registered with ipcMain.handle() in src/main/index.ts; typed only via the hand-maintained ElectronAPI interface in src/preload/electron-api.d.ts, implemented in src/preload/index.ts and exposed via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('electron', ...); renderer calls window.electron.*. Response convention: { success: boolean; data?: T; error?: string }. Push events use webContents.send + on* subscription functions in preload that return unsubscribe closures. contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, sandbox: false. Main process is intentionally thin: window/lifecycle, native menus/zoom/fullscreen/notifications, OAuth device flow (no CORS), SQLite persistence (--module-persistence/main with Drizzle schema.ts, connection.ts, ipc-handlers.ts 'db:*' channels, repositories/), electron-store (src/main/store.ts). Window: 1400x900 min 1000x700, titleBarStyle 'hiddenInset', trafficLightPosition {x:12,y:18}, backgroundColor '#0d1117', opens fullscreen.

--module-ui-kit is shadcn/ui-style: ~35 component folders, each folder = one component + index.ts barrel + co-located .test.tsx (e.g. button/{Button.tsx, Button.test.tsx, index.ts}). Single top-level barrel --module-ui-kit/index.ts re-exports everything with explicit named exports + types (required by isolatedDeclarations). Components: Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button (cva buttonVariants), Card, CodeHighlight, CodeViewer, Dialog, DiffViewer, FileHeader, FileTabBar, Flex, FloatingWindow, Grid (Container/Row/Col 12-col responsive system — house rule: use it instead of raw flex/grid), Input, Label, ListMenu, MarkdownContent, MarkdownEditor, MatchedAvatars, Popover, Progress, ResizeHandle, ScrollArea, Select, Separator, Sheet, Skeleton, Slider, Tabs, Textarea, ThinkingSection (AI-only), Timeline, Toaster/toast, Toggle, Tooltip, TreeView, ViewHeader, plus utils (cn = clsx+tailwind-merge, formatRelativeTime, groupBy, truncate) and brand components claude-icon + codelobby-logo (AI/brand-specific, replace in new app). House rules from knowledge/claude.md: never use raw HTML elements when an @ui-kit component exists; single TooltipProvider at app root; Toaster mounted once in App.

findings.topic: 3. Theming system (OKLCH tokens, generator, dark mode, elevation)
findings.detail: Single source of truth is src/renderer/styles/theme.config.mjs: exports roles ({neutral: hue 264, primary: 250, destructive: 27, success: 155, warning: 80, info: 250}) plus lightTokens/darkTokens maps where each token = {role, l, c}. scripts/generate-theme.mjs ('pnpm generate:theme') validates (role exists, l 0-1, c 0-0.4, WCAG-approx contrast foreground/background >= 4.5:1, elevation ordering) then injects raw OKLCH channel triplets ('L C H') into globals.css between marker comments /* GENERATED:LIGHT:START */ ... END and /* GENERATED:DARK:START */ ... END inside :root and .dark. Variables store channels only so Tailwind can do opacity: tailwind.config.js maps every color as "oklch(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)". Semantic token names: background, surface-content, surface, surface-raised, header, surface-hover, overlay; foreground + -muted/-subtle/-ghost (4-level text); border + -muted/-subtle (3-level); interactive-hover/-active; primary/-foreground; destructive/success/warning/info each with -foreground/-subtle/-border variants; input, ring; chat-bg/chat-bubble; code-bg/code-fg. Backward-compat aliases in globals.css (--card, --popover, --secondary, --muted, --accent map to the new tokens). ELEVATION: light mode = higher elevation is DARKER (background L=1.000 -> surface-content 0.978 -> surface 0.958 -> surface-raised 0.944 -> header 0.850); dark mode = higher elevation is LIGHTER (background 0.145 -> surface-content 0.160 -> surface 0.185 -> surface-raised 0.202 -> header 0.310); overlay is white in light / L=0.275 in dark. Documented in docs/THEMING.md ('Level 0 --background content ... Level 4 --overlay popovers'; structural surfaces use solid colors, no bg-card/80 opacity tricks). DARK MODE SWITCHING: Tailwind darkMode: ["class"]. ThemeVariant = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'; persisted in localStorage key 'codelobby-theme'; useTheme() query (--module-data/queries/system.ts, key keys.system.theme = ['system','theme']) reads localStorage (default 'dark'), applies via applyThemeClasses() -> document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark), and while in 'system' subscribes to matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') changes. useSetTheme() mutation (--module-data/mutations/system.ts) writes localStorage + applies class + setQueryData. Toggle UI lives in --module-header/components/Header.tsx. Also in globals.css: radius scale (--radius-xs 4px … --radius-xl 12px), motion vars (--ease cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), --duration-fast 150ms / --duration 200ms / --duration-slow 350ms), elevation shadows (--shadow-elevation-low/medium/high, different per mode), .header-bar frosted-glass class (oklch(var(--header) / 0.66) + backdrop blur), .section-header (chrome-zone) vs .content-header (content-zone), .panel-slide / .panel-slide-v transitions (350ms), syntax-highlight and diff-tint variables. tailwind.config.js also defines boxShadow elevation-* + apple-* statics, transition durations from CSS vars, fontFamily SF Pro system stack + SF Mono, and keyframes/animations: accordion, pulse-glow, slide-in-from-{right,left,top,bottom} (+ slide-out), fade-in/out, progress-indeterminate, and 'skeleton' (opacity 1 -> 0.65 pulse, 2.5s ease-in-out infinite). content globs: './src/renderer/**/*.{ts,tsx,html}' and './--module-*/**/*.{ts,tsx}'.

findings.topic: 4. Loading-state patterns and TanStack Query conventions
findings.detail: Skeletons: ui-kit Skeleton = <div className="animate-skeleton rounded-md bg-border-muted"> (custom 2.5s opacity pulse, NOT animate-pulse). Layout-matching skeleton pattern: --module-pr-detail/components/PRDetailSkeleton/PRDetailSkeleton.tsx mirrors PRDetail's exact layout ('Matches the exact layout of PRDetail to avoid page shifting during load') and PRDetail.tsx renders it when `isLoadingDetails || !pr` (line ~207). Slot fallback: SlotSkeleton (animate-pulse bg-surface) as Suspense fallback in --module-slot-system/index.tsx. ANTI-FLASH: no global minimum-loading-duration hook exists; instead (a) usePanelPresence(active, 350ms) in --module-app/App.tsx keeps panel content mounted for one --duration-slow slide so content rides the collapse animation; (b) documented two-phase loading pattern in knowledge/claude.md (isLoading + isContentReady, skeleton overlay stays until virtualizer measures/scrolls); (c) usePRs() only reports isLoading when ALL per-repo queries are loading AND none has data, avoiding skeleton flash on incremental repo additions. QUERY CLIENT (--module-data/client.ts): staleTime 1h, gcTime 7d, retry 1, refetchOnWindowFocus true; mutations retry 0; persisted to localStorage via createSyncStoragePersister + persistQueryClient with maxAge 30d and shouldDehydrateQuery persisting only keys whose first segment is 'settings' | 'ai' | 'local' ('github' data always fetched fresh); isQueryCacheHydrated()/waitForHydration() helpers. QUERY KEYS (--module-data/keys.ts): single `keys` object; namespaces by first segment — 'github' (fresh), 'settings' (persisted), 'ai' (persisted), 'local' (persisted UI state), 'network' (runtime only), 'system' (OS state, staleTime Infinity). Hierarchical keys for invalidation, e.g. keys.pr(repo, n) = ['github','pr',repo,n] is the prefix of prDetail/prFiles so one invalidateQueries clears all PR data; factory functions typed as readonly tuples (isolatedDeclarations). CUSTOM HOOK CONVENTION: every query/mutation wrapped in a named hook (useXxx) in --module-data/queries/* or /mutations/*, explicit UseQueryResult/UseMutationResult return types; per-entity cache times as module constants (e.g. PR_CACHE_TIME = 15 * 60 * 1000); useQueries for per-repo fan-out; local-storage-backed queries use queryFn reading localStorage with staleTime Infinity and mutations that write localStorage then setQueryData.

Vitest 2.1.9 + happy-dom (chosen over jsdom for speed, per comment in vitest.config.ts) + React Testing Library + @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest + user-event. Config: vitest.config.ts — globals: true, environment 'happy-dom', setupFiles ['./--module-test-utils/setup.ts'], include: src/main/**/*.test.ts, src/renderer/**/*.test.ts, --module-*/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}; coverage provider 'v8', reporters ['text','json','html','cobertura','json-summary'], global thresholds 85% branches/functions/lines/statements, excludes types.ts, *.d.ts, configs, and the structurally-uncoverable Electron entry points src/main/index.ts + src/preload/index.ts. 128 test files, co-located next to source (Component.test.tsx beside Component.tsx; a few __tests__ dirs in --module-persistence). --module-test-utils provides: setup.ts (ResizeObserver mock, beforeEach localStorage.clear + setupMockElectron from mocks/electron — a full window.electron mock), render.tsx (customRender exported as `render` wrapping QueryClientProvider + TooltipProvider, createTestQueryClient with retry false / staleTime & gcTime Infinity / refetch* false, initializeTestState seeding localStorage + query cache from options like initialUser/initialSelectedPR/initialViewMode), and re-exports of @testing-library/react. What is tested: ui-kit components (Button.test.tsx, Skeleton.test.tsx, view-header.test.tsx), data queries/mutations (settings.test.tsx, accounts.test.tsx, keys.test.ts, client.test.ts, github.test.ts), app shell (App.test.tsx, TokenInput.test.tsx), main-process units (github-auth.test.ts, http-client.test.ts), persistence (__tests__). Run: pnpm test (vitest run), test:watch, test:coverage, test:ui; also run in husky pre-commit and CI shards.

test.yml (push/PR to main), 5 jobs: (1) 'changes' — dorny/paths-filter@v3 detects code-relevant paths (src/**, --module-*/**, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, tsconfig*.json, biome.json, vitest.config.ts, electron.vite.config.ts, drizzle*, tailwind/postcss configs, the workflow itself) so docs/site-only changes skip heavy jobs; (2) 'lint-typecheck' — pnpm/action-setup@v4 version 10, setup-node@v4 node 20 cache pnpm, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck; (3) 'unit' — matrix shard [1,2,3], `pnpm exec vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=blob --shard=${{matrix.shard}}/3`, uploads .vitest-reports/* blob artifacts (retention 1 day); (4) 'coverage' — downloads blobs, `pnpm exec vitest run --merge-reports --coverage` (suite runs once, not twice), posts PR comment via davelosert/vitest-coverage-report-action@v2 (file-coverage-mode: changes), then installs python diff-cover and enforces `diff-cover coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml --compare-branch=origin/$BASE --fail-under=90` — 90% coverage on CHANGED lines; (5) 'test' — aggregate always()-running gate whose name matches the required branch-protection check; passes if code jobs succeeded OR were skipped, fails on failure/cancelled. pr-title-lint.yml — amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v5 enforcing Conventional Commit PR titles (types feat|fix|docs|chore|ci|build|refactor|perf|test|style|revert, subject must start lowercase via subjectPattern ^(?![A-Z]).+$) because repo squash-merges with PR title as commit message. release-drafter.yml — release-drafter/release-drafter@v6 on push to main + PR autolabeler; uses secrets.RELEASE_PAT fallback GITHUB_TOKEN so the draft is user-owned (bot-owned releases wouldn't trigger release.yml); config in .github/release-drafter.yml. release.yml — on release published; macos-latest; pnpm 10 + node 20; pnpm run build; then `pnpm exec electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always -c.extraMetadata.version=<tag minus v>` with GH_TOKEN and CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: false (explicitly unsigned; docs/RELEASING.md documents future signing: add CSC_LINK/CSC_KEY_PASSWORD/APPLE_ID/APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD/APPLE_TEAM_ID secrets and remove that env). pages.yml — deploys static site/ dir to GitHub Pages on main pushes touching site/** (configure-pages@v5, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4, OIDC id-token, concurrency group 'pages'). Local gate: .husky/pre-commit runs npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test — all must pass.

.claude/ contains only settings.local.json (permission allowlist: sqlite3, curl, bun, pnpm typecheck/remove, WebFetch github.com etc.) — no skills, no project CLAUDE.md at repo root. The de-facto CLAUDE.md is knowledge/claude.md (~1660 lines, 'CodeLobby - AI Assistant Guidelines'). Key rules to carry into the new app (quotes): 'TanStack Query as the single source of truth for ALL state... no signals, no Redux, no custom stores'; IPC response convention '{ success: boolean; data?: T; error?: string }'; 'NEVER create raw HTML elements when a component exists in @ui-kit'; 'For any UI requiring grid layouts, use the built-in 12-column grid system from @ui-kit'; slot rule 'Each module self-registers to its slot via registerToSlot() — NO imports between modules, only to shared packages'; 'All state updates go through useMutation hooks from @data' (setQueryData forbidden in UI modules, allowed in tests); 'Never Remove Slot Registration' when refactoring; Dumb Component Pattern — presentational children get data/handlers via props, only orchestrators use @data; 'Every Component Lives in Its Own Folder' with index.ts barrel and co-located test, 'One .tsx file = One component. No exceptions'; memoize custom-hook object returns with useMemo; smooth-resize pattern (refs + rAF + direct DOM writes, state sync only on mouseup, will-change + contain); virtual-scroll rules (scrollToIndex, keep streaming content outside the virtualizer, throttle streaming to ~30fps); isolatedDeclarations requires explicit return types on all exports; 'Always add type="button"'; Apple design language section (SF Pro stack, radii 6/8/12/14px, subtle diffused shadows, active scale 0.97, cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), durations 150/250/350/500ms, 4px spacing grid); UX scannability rule 'Variable-width content -> Fixed-width indicators'; z-index scale (base 0, hover 10, toolbar 20, modal 50, tooltip 9999); logging rule 'Every API call must be logged' via --module-logger with LogCategory enum. Note: some sections of knowledge/claude.md are stale relative to code (it describes HSL variables while the code now uses generated OKLCH; docs/THEMING.md token tables also show older HSL values — theme.config.mjs + globals.css are the truth). Other knowledge docs: app_architecture.md, api_data_flow.md, features_book.md, theming.md, work_plan.md, claude-code-integration-plan.md, claude-cli-stream-json.md.

electron-builder config is inline in package.json under "build": appId com.codelobby.app, productName CodeLobby, publish [{provider: github, owner: SouhaibBenFarhat, repo: code-lobby, releaseType: release}], directories.buildResources 'build', files ['out/**/*'] (electron-vite outputs to out/main, out/preload, out/renderer; "main": "./out/main/index.js"), extraResources copies drizzle/ SQL migrations + meta into the app bundle (needed at runtime for SQLite migration). Targets: mac -> dmg with artifactName 'CodeLobby-${arch}.${ext}', icon build/icon.icns, extendInfo build/Info.plist; win -> nsis (build/icon.png); linux -> AppImage. Release build command in CI: electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always -c.extraMetadata.version=<git tag> — package.json version is only a fallback, versioning is computed by Release Drafter from Conventional-Commit PR labels (feat=minor, fix=patch, breaking=major). Code signing: currently NONE (CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: false in release.yml); notarization not set up; docs/RELEASING.md documents the exact secrets/steps to add it later. Auto-update: NOT wired (no electron-updater dependency), but latest-mac.yml + blockmap are already published with each release so electron-updater can be added later (requires signed builds). Native module handling: postinstall runs electron-rebuild + electron-builder install-app-deps for better-sqlite3; scripts/patch-electron-name.js patches dev app name. Local packaging scripts: build:unpack (--dir), build:mac/win/linux.

findings.topic: 9. AI plug-in points (EXCLUDE from the new app)
findings.detail: AI touches these places — everything else is AI-free and reusable as-is: (1) --module-ai-chat/ entire module (registered to 'ai-panel' slot) and its alias '@ai-chat' in electron.vite.config.ts / tsconfig.web.json / vitest.config.ts / biome.json overrides / bootstrap.ts import; (2) src/main AI files: claude-cli.ts, claude-cli-path.ts, claude-cli-usage.ts, ai-pricing.ts, system-prompt.ts, prompts/ dir, and the large blocks of ipcMain.handle channels in src/main/index.ts (send-chat-message*, claude:*, analyze-*, extract-jira-ticket, get-ai-*, pr-chat ops) plus matching store.ts chat/AI state; (3) preload: all AI members of ElectronAPI (sendChatMessage*, onChatStreamChunk, startClaudeSession, onClaude*, getAIUsage, db.aiUsage etc.) in src/preload/index.ts + electron-api.d.ts; (4) --module-data: claude-code/ subdir, github-auth AI-adjacent nothing, keys under the 'ai' namespace in keys.ts, mutations/ai.ts, queries/ai.ts, and 'ai' in the persistence whitelist in client.ts shouldDehydrateQuery; (5) ui-kit: claude-icon/ and thinking-section/ components; (6) persistence: aiUsage table in --module-persistence/main/schema.ts and repositories/ai-usage.ts (conversations/messages tables are chat-specific too); (7) --module-header/components/AICostIndicator.tsx; (8) App.tsx AI-panel wiring (useAIPanel, useClaudeStreamListener, ai-panel slot rendering). The generic scaffolding to KEEP: slot system, @data query/mutation architecture + localStorage persistence, ui-kit (minus the two AI components), theming pipeline, logger, test-utils, persistence module pattern (SQLite+Drizzle, 'db:*' IPC), network panel, CI/release pipeline.

findings.topic: Blueprint checklist for the new job-postings aggregator
findings.detail: Concrete mapping: keep src/{main,preload,renderer} + top-level module dirs (rename prefix if desired, but keep the alias-based module isolation and Biome layered-import enforcement). Modules to create: @data (jobs queries: job boards fetched via direct fetch() from renderer with ETag-aware http.ts; keys namespaced 'jobs' fresh / 'settings' 'local' persisted), @ui-kit (copy wholesale minus claude-icon/thinking-section, rename codelobby-logo), @slot-system (copy verbatim — it is fully generic), @test-utils (copy, replace electron mock surface), @logger (copy verbatim), @persistence (copy pattern; schema for saved jobs/notes instead of conversations), feature modules like @header, @explorer (source list), @job-detail (mirror pr-detail incl. JobDetailSkeleton layout-matching skeleton), @network. Copy verbatim: theme.config.mjs + generate-theme.mjs + globals.css markers (change 'codelobby-theme' localStorage key and brand hue), tailwind.config.js, tsconfig trio, vitest.config.ts (update aliases), biome.json (update module names in overrides), .husky/pre-commit, all 5 workflows (rename product/appId/owner/repo), docs/RELEASING.md + docs/THEMING.md as templates, and a knowledge/claude.md trimmed of AI sections. Main process for the new app shrinks to: window/lifecycle/menu/zoom, notifications, shell-open-external, persistence IPC, maybe auth device-flow if a job API needs it.

summary:
CodeLobby (/Users/souhaib.farhat/Desktop/Souhaib-DEV/codelobby) is an Electron 28 + React 18 desktop app (GitHub PR monitor) built with electron-vite 2 (Vite 5), TypeScript 5.9 (3 tsconfigs with project references and isolatedDeclarations), Tailwind CSS v3 (classic tailwind.config.js + PostCSS/autoprefixer — not v4), Radix primitives in a shadcn-style ui-kit, TanStack Query v5 (+ persist-client with localStorage and react-virtual; no TanStack Router — no router at all), Biome 2 for lint+format (no ESLint/Prettier), Vitest 2 + happy-dom + RTL for tests, electron-builder 24 for packaging, pnpm >= 10, and Husky pre-commit running lint+typecheck+tests.

Its defining architecture: Electron process code lives in src/{main,preload,renderer} (renderer is just an entry point), while ALL app code lives in top-level `--module-*` directories acting as pseudo-packages wired through path aliases duplicated across electron.vite.config.ts, tsconfig.web.json and vitest.config.ts. A tiny slot system (--module-slot-system) lets feature modules self-register components into named slots so UI modules have zero cross-imports; a strict level hierarchy (L0 logger -> L1 ui-kit/data -> L2 slot-system/test-utils -> L3 feature modules -> L4 app) is mechanically enforced by per-module Biome noRestrictedImports overrides. TanStack Query is the single source of truth for ALL state — server data, settings, and UI state alike — read via useQuery hooks and written only via useMutation hooks from --module-data, with 'settings'/'ai'/'local' key namespaces persisted to localStorage and 'github' data always fresh. IPC is a thin, hand-typed contextBridge surface (kebab-case invoke channels, `{success, data?, error?}` responses) reserved for OS/native concerns plus SQLite (better-sqlite3 + Drizzle) persistence; business/API logic runs in the renderer via direct fetch with an ETag-caching http client.

Theming is generator-driven: an OKLCH token config (theme.config.mjs) is validated and compiled by scripts/generate-theme.mjs into CSS channel variables between markers in globals.css, consumed by Tailwind as `oklch(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)`. Semantic tokens cover a 5-level elevation ladder (background -> surface-content -> surface -> surface-raised -> header, darker as it rises in light mode, lighter in dark mode), 4-level text and 3-level border hierarchies, and status color families; dark mode is a `.dark` class on <html> managed by a useTheme query + useSetTheme mutation persisted in localStorage with 'system' following prefers-color-scheme. CI (5 workflows) runs paths-filtered lint/typecheck plus 3-way sharded Vitest with merged coverage, a 90% diff-cover patch gate and an always-reporting aggregate `test` check; releases are Conventional-Commit-PR-title driven via Release Drafter, and publishing the draft triggers an unsigned arm64 DMG build uploaded by electron-builder. AI features (the --module-ai-chat panel, Claude CLI integration in src/main, the claude-code subfolder of --module-data, 'ai' query keys, two ui-kit components and assorted IPC/preload surface) are cleanly localized and enumerable for exclusion in the new job-postings app.
